caption: High-fidelity mobile UI, bright and clean e-commerce app, light green and white color palette. The screen features a search bar at the top with the text 'Search Groupon', followed by a location indicator and a shopping cart icon. Below, a horizontal scrollable category list with icons and labels such as 'Goods', 'Things To Do', 'Beauty & Spas', 'Restaurants', and 'Travel'. A hero image showcases an offer for 'New Girl in Town' with a 'NEW' badge. Underneath, the offer title '"New Girl in Town"' and location 'Northern Waterfront' are displayed, along with pricing details showing a discount from '$25' to '$16.50'. A bottom navigation bar includes icons and labels for 'Featured', 'Search', 'Notifications' (with a notification badge), and 'My Stuff'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, corporate trucking theme, blue and yellow color palette, slightly dated aesthetic. Login screen with a full-screen background image of a truck. The logo 'DRIVE WERNER' is at the top in outlined yellow text. Below are white text fields for 'Username' and 'Password'. A 'Remember Me' checkbox is present. A primary CTA 'LOG IN' is centered. 'LOGIN HELP' and 'ACCOUNT RECOVERY / NEW ACCOUNT' are at the bottom.

High-fidelity mobile UI, onboarding flow, bright and airy aesthetic, pastel green and yellow color palette, clean design. The screen features a circular logo with a palm tree icon and a sun. Below, the heading reads 'Welcome to TripAdvisor!' followed by the subtext 'Your ultimate travel resource - helping you make the most of every trip.'. A primary CTA button with rounded corners reads 'CONTINUE'. At the bottom, there's a pagination indicator and a right arrow icon.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean e-commerce app, neutral color palette with white background. The screen features a 'Shop' title and search icon in the top app bar. Below are category tabs: 'Men', 'Women', 'Boys', 'Girls'.  The main content area shows a full-width hero image with the text overlay 'New & Featured'. A second full-width image showcases 'Shoes'. A bottom navigation bar contains icons for Home, Search, Favorites, Bag, and Profile.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and simple design, light beige and white color palette. The screen displays a list of categories. The top bar includes a hamburger menu icon and the text 'English (5676)' with a dropdown arrow, and a search icon. Below, a breadcrumb navigation shows 'English > Free'. The main content area presents two card components with rounded corners, each containing a theatrical mask icon, title 'Free books' with '5444' below, and 'Magazine' with '160' below respectively.

High-fidelity mobile UI, travel booking app, bright and clean aesthetic, light blue and white color palette. The screen displays a list of hotel properties. At the top is a search bar for 'Acapulco, 2 adults, 8 nights'. Below is a banner promoting 'Book Now, Pay When You Stay!'. The main content area shows hotel cards with hero images, titles like 'Las Brisas Acapulco', star ratings, location details, review scores, and pricing '8 nights from US$774.32'. A green CTA reads 'No Surprises! Final price.'. The bottom nav bar contains 'Sort', 'Filter', and 'Map' buttons.

High-fidelity mobile UI, modern login screen, purple background with a subtle blurred image. The screen features a clean layout with a clear visual hierarchy. The main title reads 'Enter Anghami with one tap!' followed by a subtitle. Below are two prominent login buttons: a blue button labeled 'Login with Facebook' and a white button labeled 'Login with Google'. A disclaimer is placed below the buttons. At the bottom of the screen are two text links: 'Other login options' and 'Need help?'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and simple design, light mode, pastel blue accent color. A 'Sign Up' screen with a back arrow in the top-left corner. Below, a circular 'Set Photo' button with a blue border and a placeholder image icon. Input fields labeled 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Username', 'Email', 'Password', 'Birthday', and 'Phone (Recommended)'. A primary CTA button at the bottom reads 'SIGN UP' in white text on a blue background. Small text below the button states "By tapping 'Sign Up' you agree to Kik's terms and privacy policy".

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern, light teal and white color palette, with a focus on deals and offers. The screen features a full-width hero image with the 'IRCTC Website' logo and a cashback offer. Below, a segmented control with 'Popular Offers', 'Nearby Stores', and 'Restaurants'. A horizontal scrollable list displays 'Nearby Stores' with card components showing logos like 'WHSmith' and 'RICHFEEL', along with text like 'Get 20% cashback' and a 'Cashback' tag. Another section shows 'Restaurants' with 'Wow Momo' and 'Sagar Ratna' logos, and a 'Freebies' offer tag. A floating action button (FAB) with a search icon is positioned at the bottom right.

High-fidelity mobile UI, travel app, light mode, pastel color palette. The screen displays a travel planning interface. The header contains a hamburger menu icon on the left and the title 'Your trips' in the center, with a vertical ellipsis icon on the right. Below the header is a search bar with the placeholder text 'Where do you want to go?' and a search icon. Underneath is the label 'Explore', followed by a carousel of destination cards. The visible card displays a hero image of the New York skyline and the text 'New York' overlaid on the image's top-left. A pagination indicator is at the bottom of the card.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern event planning app, bright pink and gray color scheme, flat design. The screen features a top pink header with 'Virtual Planner' title and an info icon. Below are three full-width image cards with overlaid text: 'Coordinator' over a cocktail image, 'Engagement Photography' over a couple, and 'Beauty Stylist' over a hair styling image. A pink FAB with a white edit icon is positioned on the bottom right. A bottom navigation bar contains icons and labels for 'To-do', 'Registry', 'Vendor', 'Guest', 'Organizer', and 'Me'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, onboarding flow, monochromatic teal color palette, clean and modern. The screen features a full-screen gradient teal background. White, sans-serif text at the top reads 'Now, Airbnb is more than just homes. Book your whole trip — all from one app.'. At the bottom is a rounded rectangle primary CTA button with the text 'Let's go' in a sans-serif font.

High-fidelity mobile UI, vibrant and modern, with a bright color palette and flat design elements. The screen displays a 'Collections' view with a top app bar containing a menu icon and search icon. Below, a 'FEATURED' label sits above a grid layout of card components. Each card contains an image, title, author, and a 'FOLLOW' button. Example cards include "in a crystal Ball" by julia larrigue, "Music Technology" by Danie van der Merwe, "Neuroscience" by Neuroscience News, and "Technology" by CJ Dulberger. A bottom navigation bar includes icons and labels for 'Home', 'Collections', 'Communities', and 'Notifications'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, modern train travel app, dark blue and teal color palette, clean and functional design. The screen shows a segmented control with 'PLAN & BUY' selected and 'LIVE TIMES' as the alternative. Below are input fields labeled 'from Departure station' and 'to Arrival station' with a swap icon. A modal appears with a 'NEW' badge and the title 'Improved live times features', followed by a list of checkmarked features. The modal has a dismiss button 'OK, GOT IT X'. At the bottom is a full-width primary CTA button that reads 'Find trains'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, Airbnb-style, bright and airy aesthetic, pastel teal and white color palette. A search bar at the top reads 'Anywhere · Anytime · 1 guest'. Below, a segmented control with labels 'FOR YOU', 'HOMES', 'EXPERIENCES', 'PLACES', with 'EXPERIENCES' highlighted. A grid layout displays experience cards. The first card shows a wine tasting image, with text '$28 1 hour · wine & wine tasting'. The second card shows an art image, with text '$51 2 hours · art & painting'. A 'Filters' button is present. A bottom navigation bar includes icons and labels: 'EXPLORE', 'SAVED', 'TRIPS', 'INBOX', 'PROFILE'. Each card has a heart icon for saving.

High-fidelity mobile UI, cheerful and motivational app design, bright teal and yellow color palette with rainbow accents. The screen features a top app bar with a hamburger menu icon, the app title 'Fabulous', and a plus icon. Below is a banner displaying '0/27 events achieved' with a rainbow graphic. A list view shows several tasks: 'Drink Water' (status 'Not yet started'), 'Great Breakfast', 'Dance your Way', 'Golden Challenge', and 'Secret Letter', all with the status 'Not yet unlocked'. Each task has a corresponding icon.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern, pastel color palette with a focus on whitespace. Onboarding screen for a real estate app. The Trulia logo is at the top. Below is a stylized icon of a house and tree. The main headline reads 'Let's start searching for a home'. Supporting copy: 'This is your activity feed. As you start to search it will fill up with information personalized to you.' A rounded rectangle primary CTA button reads 'Start Your Search'. The bottom nav bar contains icons and labels for 'Feed', 'Search', 'Saves', 'Alerts', and 'More'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, modern music streaming app, light mode, neutral color palette with red accents. The screen features a search bar at the top with the text 'Search and Discover new Music!'. Below is a hero image featuring the artist 'POUYA' and the text 'EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW OUT NOW! CHARM LADONNA'. A 'Trending Singles' section follows with a 'SEE MORE' link. The list view displays song titles and artist names, such as 'Lil Durk - They Forgot [Prod. By Le...]', accompanied by small album art thumbnails. A bottom navigation bar includes icons for Discover, History, Trending, Video, and Library.

High-fidelity mobile UI, wellness tracker app, flat vector style, dark indigo background with light text. The screen displays a 'Health Log' with a 'NEXT' button in the upper right. The main content is divided into sections with questions like 'Why are you feeling this way?' followed by a horizontal list of circular icons with labels: 'Love Life', 'Friends' (with a green checkmark), 'Family', 'School', and 'Work'. Subsequent sections ask 'Experiencing any symptoms?' with icons for 'Cramps', 'Tender Breasts', 'Acne', 'Headache' (with a green checkmark), and 'Bloating'; 'Did you exercise?' with icons for 'Cardio' (with a green checkmark), 'Yoga/Pilates', 'Toning', and 'Other'; and 'Did you indulge?' with icons for 'Sweets', 'Salty Snacks', and 'Alcohol'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, onboarding flow, clean and modern, predominantly white with purple accent color. The screen displays 'Stay Connected to the Cars You're Considering' as a heading. Below are three circular list items, each with a gray circular background. The first contains a car icon with a heart, accompanied by the text 'Save the cars you like'. The second has a bell icon and the text 'Get price drop notifications'. The third shows chat bubbles and the text 'Contact sellers anonymously'. A 'SKIP' link is at the top right. Page indicator dots are at the bottom.

High-fidelity mobile UI, travel discovery app, clean and modern, light mode with a muted gray background. The main feed features a search bar at the top with the placeholder text 'Search by destination or activity' and a shopping cart icon. Below, a section titled 'Trending Now' displays a full-width card with a lifestyle hero image and overlaid text 'Maybe it's Cold Outside' with a subtitle. Next is a section titled 'Klook Preferred' with a card featuring a nature image and a location pin with the text 'Sydney'. A bottom navigation bar contains icons and labels for 'Explore', 'Destinations', 'Categories', 'Bookings', and 'Account'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and simple design, light theme, with a primary red accent color. The screen displays a card list with a top navigation bar containing 'Stocard' title, 'My Cards' and 'Offers' tabs, and a settings icon. Below, two card previews are displayed. The main content area contains the text 'Add your cards here' and 'Adding your first card only takes seconds!', followed by a red 'ADD CARD' button. A red FAB is positioned at the bottom right.

High-fidelity mobile UI, Airbnb style, bright and airy aesthetic, pastel teal and white color palette. The screen features a search bar at the top with the text 'Anywhere. Anytime. 1 guest'. Below is a segmented control with labels 'FOR YOU', 'HOMES', 'EXPERIENCES', and 'PLACES'. A list view displays property listings, each with a hero image, price (e.g., '$81'), title 'Private room in London', star rating, and review count '156 Reviews'. Below the first listing is another listing with a hero image and two buttons 'MAP' and 'FILTERS'. A bottom navigation bar contains icons and labels: 'EXPLORE', 'SAVED', 'TRIPS', 'INBOX', and 'PROFILE'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, calming and serene aesthetic, muted teal and gray color palette, flat vector illustration style. Onboarding screen with a full-screen illustration of a person relaxing outdoors with a backpack. Below the illustration is a headline 'Stress-free planning' and supporting copy 'Get personalized activity ideas based on the time, place, and weather'. A primary CTA button 'GET STARTED' is centered below the copy. Page indicator dots are at the bottom.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and simple login screen, light mode, primary blue accent color. The layout features a top blue banner with the 'GMX' logo. Below, a welcome message 'Welcome to your GMX App!' is displayed next to a GMX logo. Two input fields labeled 'Email' and 'Password' with underlines. Underneath are two text links, 'Lost Password?' and 'Get your free email account'. At the bottom are two buttons, 'MANUAL SETUP' and 'LOGIN'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, e-commerce app, pastel color palette, clean and modern design. The screen is divided into two sections with product images. The top section shows rain boots and umbrellas, with text labels 'RAINCOATS, RAIN BOOTS, UMBRELLAS' and 'Get rain ready!'. The bottom section features hats, gloves, and scarves, with text labels 'HATS, GLOVES, SCARVES' and 'Discounts against cold weather!'. A bottom navigation bar contains icons for home, search, cart, and profile.

High-fidelity mobile UI, travel booking app, clean and bright aesthetic, with a primary blue color scheme. The screen displays a list view of hotel options. Each list item is a card component with a hotel room photo at the top. Below the image is the hotel name, such as 'Sofitel London Heathrow', followed by the distance 'West Drayton - 16.1 miles away', a five-star rating, and a green 'Excellent' badge. The price '$202.52' is displayed on the right. The second card shows 'Rosewood London' with a price of '$855.85'. The top navigation bar shows 'London, United Kingdom' with icons for 'Sort', 'Filter', and 'Map'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern design, with a cool-toned color palette of blues and whites. The screen features a stylized illustration of a phone and receipt at the top. Below the illustration is the text 'Get personalised pre-paid recharge plans meant only for you!'. There are three dot page indicators. The next section contains the text 'To experience the power of MobiKwik, enter your mobile number below' followed by a text field with '+91 4152739840' pre-filled. A primary CTA 'Send OTP' is below the text field. A 'Skip' link is at the bottom right.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern, bright color palette with a blue background and white form fields. A 'Sign Up' screen with a top-left back arrow. The 'EasyBox' logo is centered at the top. Below the logo are four stacked white text fields with light blue icons and labels: 'Name', 'Email', 'Password', and 'Confirm Password'. A checkbox and text 'I have read and accepted the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy' are above a rounded-corner primary CTA button labeled 'SUBMIT'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean e-commerce style, light and airy, pastel accent colors. A category list view for furniture shopping. The header contains a logo and search bar with the placeholder text 'Find anything for your home...' and a shopping cart icon. Below the header is a section title 'Bedroom Furniture'. The list view consists of rows with furniture category names and corresponding thumbnail images, including 'Beds', 'Headboards', 'Dressers', 'Nightstands', 'Bedroom Sets', 'Bedroom Vanities', 'Bedroom Benches', 'Armoires', 'Daybeds', and 'Jewelry Armoires'. A bottom navigation bar includes icons and labels for 'Home', 'Shop', 'My Boards', and 'Account'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and simple list view, bright and airy aesthetic, light purple and white color palette. The screen displays a list of charts. At the top is a purple header with a white 'X' icon on the left and the title 'Charts' centered. Below the header is a list of items, each with a thumbnail image on the left and a title on the right, such as 'The Official Lebanese Top 20 (OLT20)', 'Top Arabic in Morocco', 'Top Arabic in Qatar', 'Top Arabic in Saudi', 'Top Arabic in UAE', 'Top Arabic Algeria', 'Top Arabic Oman', 'Top Arabic Palestine', and 'Top Arabic Syria'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, dark mode music app, minimalist design, muted gray color palette. Onboarding screen prompting user to select favorite artists. The screen displays a grid of circular artist avatars with names below. One avatar, 'Coldplay', has a checkmark overlay. Above the grid is the prompt text: 'Tap on the artists you like' and 'Your experience will improve the more you listen'. At the bottom are two buttons: 'CANCEL' and 'DONE'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern aesthetic, light mode, with a primary teal accent color. A login modal overlaying a blurred background. The modal contains a 'Sign in with Facebook' button with a Facebook 'f' icon, and a 'Sign in with Google' button with a Google 'G' icon. Below are 'Email' and 'Password' text fields with subtle underlines. A 'Forgot your password?' link is present. A primary teal 'Log in' button is above a 'Sign up' text link. A chevron icon is at the top of the modal.

High-fidelity mobile UI, travel booking app, bright and clean design, primary colors. The screen shows a search form with a yellow background. It features a text field for 'Acapulco' with a search icon. Below are two side-by-side fields for 'Check-in Tue, February 07' and 'Check-out Wed, February 08'. Further below are fields for 'Room 1', 'Adults 2', and 'Children 0'. Radio buttons are present for 'Traveling for: Business Leisure'. A large blue primary CTA at the bottom reads 'Let's go! (91)'. The top navigation bar contains the Booking.com logo.

High-fidelity mobile UI, adventure travel theme, muted color palette with dark overlay. A full-screen hero image of a camper van in a mountain landscape with a dark gradient overlay. The top left corner has a white 'X' icon. Centered is a white outlined 'TURO' logo. Below, in white text, is the heading 'Start your adventure'. A primary CTA 'Sign up' in a light green color, and a secondary button 'Log in' with a white outline.

High-fidelity mobile UI, vibrant and playful, with a clean white background and a coral-colored header. The screen displays an interest selection flow. The header contains a back arrow and the text 'Add new interests' on the left, and a 'DONE' button on the right. Below the header is the title 'YOU'RE ALMOST DONE!' and descriptive text. A vertical list view follows, with each row containing a thumbnail image, the interest name (e.g., 'Alcoholic Drinks', 'Animals', 'Arts', 'Beauty', 'Beer'), the number of followers (e.g., '195K Followers'), and an unchecked square checkbox on the right.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and bright food app, pastel color palette, with a focus on visual clarity. A modal screen with the title 'Personalize your feed!' and subtitle 'Add 3 or more Tastes to help us serve up better recommendations for you.'. The main content is a 3x3 grid of square image cards, each with a food photo and a text label: 'Appetizers & Snacks', 'Asian', 'BBQ & Grilling', 'Beef', 'Bread', 'Breakfast & Brunch', 'Budget Cooking', 'Cake', 'Casseroles'. An orange primary CTA at the bottom reads 'Done'. A close icon is in the top right corner.

High-fidelity mobile UI, e-commerce product listing, clean and bright aesthetic, neutral color palette with white background. A search bar with a magnifying glass icon and the text 'Search' is at the top, with a 'Cancel' button to the right. Below is a product image with a heart icon for saving. The product details include the brand 'SUPPLY', the product name 'Boundless Pima Thread 50wt Cone 5000 Yards', and the price 'US$33.15 US$39.00'. Another product image is shown below.

High-fidelity mobile UI, real estate app, bright and airy aesthetic, blue and white color palette. A clean home screen with a hero background image of a suburban neighborhood at sunset. The header contains the 'realtor.com' logo and 'LOGIN / SIGN UP' links. Below, the title 'Start your search' and a segmented control with 'FOR SALE' and 'FOR RENT'. A prominent search bar with the placeholder text 'City, Zip, School, or Address in US'. Two buttons labeled 'Search by commute' and 'Search nearby' are separated by the text 'OR'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, e-commerce fashion retail, soft and airy aesthetic, pastel color accents on a clean white layout. The top app bar contains a hamburger menu, H&M logo, barcode icon, search icon, and bag icon. A promotional banner reads 'LAST DAY! FESTIVAL SHOP UP TO 50% OFF'. Below, a hero image showcases a woman in a white dress with the text 'TRY THE TREND NOVEL ROMANCE'. A list view follows, presenting black and white photos with text overlays like 'WOMEN'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, clean and modern design, light gray background with subtle shadows. A grid layout of rounded-corner cards with category images and labels. The title is 'What are you interested in?' with subtitle 'Pick whatever catches your eye... you can always fine-tune things later'.  The cards are labeled: 'Food and drink', 'Hair and beauty', 'Home decor', 'Hairstyles', 'Humor', 'Quotes', 'Makeup', 'DIY home decor', 'Recipes'. Some cards have a selected state indicated by a blue checkmark icon. At the bottom is a blue bar with the text 'Pick 2 (or more!)'.

High-fidelity mobile UI, modern travel app, soft pastel color palette with a gradient background. Full-screen splash screen with a landscape hero image. The 'agoda' logo is positioned at the top-left. Below the logo is a text block stating, 'By using our app, you acknowledge our Terms of Use and our Privacy and Cookie Policy.'. At the bottom is a primary CTA button with the text 'Got it'.
